page.layout: One printed page of running text in one column, centred on the scan. Above it: running head "CAPVT XII." with page number 317 at the right. Below the last full line: signature "Y 2" at the centre and catchword "Re-" at the right. A dark strip of the neighbouring page's edge runs along the left side and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: si talis dominatus Papæ detur, vt Reges, ac Principes iniuste deiiciat, vt sit super Eccle-siam, vt non possit errare, vt Ecclesiæ,& Con-cilio generali Ecclesiam repræsentanti, non subiiciatur: si noue istæ & peregrinæ senten-tiæ in Ecclesiam recipiantur, tum demum fi-dei catholicæ ruinam denunciant, tum de-mum Antichristo ingressum in Ecclesiam pa-refactum[?] testantur.

Quum igitur ex eo tempore in Ecclesiam Pontificiam inuaserint ista noua dogmata, nos ex Basiliensium, id est, ex auctorum nostro-rum sententia concludimus, fidem ex Pontificia Ecclesia pulsam, Antichristum vero in ea, non tam primum ingressum, sed ex eo tempore multo magis manifestatum. Ex eo enim tempore regnum Antichristi in superbia, blasphemiis æquinoctionis mendaciis, & periuriis, clandestinis regum ruinis, ho-micidiis, veneficiis, latrociniis[?] adulteriis multo apertius, atque impudentius grassari cœpit: adeo, vt Basilienses illi si hodiernum Ecclesiæ statum viderent, non dubitarent affirmare, fidem catholicam ex Ecclesia Pon-tificia penitus profligatam, Antichristum in eam ingressum, & receptum, iam sublimem regnare: ac proinde recte, atque ex officio re-formatus Ecclesias ex Antichristi iugo se sub-duxisse.
Quod si obiiciant Pontificii, non Basilienses istos fuisse Ecclesiam, sed partem illam, quæcum Eugenio Papa Florentiæ secesserant

page.notes: Left strip: edge of the neighbouring page, not transcribed. Heavy water damage and show-through across the centre and right of the page. Doubtful readings: "refactum" (line end, damaged), "latrociniis" (blurred, possibly another word of the same length), "profligatam" printed as "profugatam" or "profligatam" in damaged print (copied as "profligatam", check). "quæcum" is printed as one word and kept as printed. Catchword "Re-" is at the foot right and is not repeated in the text.
